summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Brazilian CVM/B3 material disclosure) responding to B3 Letter 344/2026-SLE after missing the November 9, 2026 amortization and interest payment on its 18th issuance debentures (R$1.2 billion across BRKMA8/BRKMB8 series, issued November 9, 2022). The company states the non-payment is protected by the 120-day stay granted August 27, 2026 by São Paulo's 2nd Bankruptcy Court upon processing its extrajudicial reorganization petition (filed August 24, 2026), covering unsecured financial obligations. No new payment date or recovery terms were disclosed; no advisor named. Watch creditor negotiations, stay expiry and plan terms.
